title.zh-CN: Microsoft Learn 文档（官方远程）

summary.zh-CN: Microsoft 官方托管的 Learn 文档服务，可检索 Microsoft、Azure、.NET、Microsoft 365 等官方文档与代码示例，并把指定文档页读取为 Markdown。无需账户，无需 API 密钥，数据经 learn.microsoft.com 传输。
summary.en: Microsoft's official hosted Learn documentation service: search official Microsoft, Azure, .NET and Microsoft 365 docs and code samples, and fetch a documentation page as Markdown. No account or API key required. Data passes through learn.microsoft.com.

description.zh-CN: 检索 Microsoft 官方文档
检索官方代码示例（可按编程语言筛选）
description.en: Search official code samples (optional language filter)

description.zh-CN: 读取指定的 Microsoft Learn 文档页并转为 Markdown
description.en: Fetch a Microsoft Learn page as Markdown

conditions.zh-CN: 数据经由 learn.microsoft.com 传输；官方为公共免费服务并设有限流（未公布具体数值），请勿批量调用
conditions.en: Data passes through learn.microsoft.com; the service is public and free with undisclosed rate limits, so do not call it in bulk

conditions.zh-CN: 官方说明工具清单可能随时调整；Teloa 只启用这里列出的三个工具
conditions.en: Microsoft states that the tool list may change; Teloa only enables the three tools listed here

conditions.zh-CN: 中国大陆访问 learn.microsoft.com 的可用性未验证
conditions.en: Availability of learn.microsoft.com from mainland China is unverified
